verdict.rationale: Vercel's automatic preview environments per Git push provide isolated, ephemeral environments for every branch/PR, enabling parallel team shipping, and collaborator commenting on previews supports concurrent team workflows. However, there's no explicit evidence of 'unlimited' guarantees, per-environment resource isolation limits, or team-scale concurrency claims/testimonials confirming this at scale. Missing for 10: explicit 'unlimited environments' claim, quantified concurrency/scale evidence, independent hands-on confirmation of team-wide simultaneous usage.
